composition.motionPreserved: All timing windows, easing curves, stagger offsets, path lengths, convergence progress, three-stage node scaling, packet cycles and phase offsets, badge pulse, erase, and caption reveal remain unchanged. Only horizontal geometry is mirrored where it expresses source-to-result reading order.

font.reason: Neutral, modern Persian UI sans that fits the source's sparse Swiss-style interface and is loaded through FaRoot.
font.fontVerification: Rendered Persian caption visibly uses Vazirmatn; shared kit loads the font before rendering.

translations.reason: Concise, natural product language for the single-result payoff.
Neutral source identifiers retained as LTR technical tokens; they are not prose or user-facing copy.

rtlDecisions.what: Four source nodes and their curves
rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored horizontally: sources occupy the right side and converge toward the badge on the left; path control points and sampled x coordinates are mirrored together.
rtlDecisions.why: Source-to-result order carries reading direction in this explanatory diagram. The nodes and packets must remain on the actual mirrored curves.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original progress formulas and phase timings; the mirrored path geometry makes the visible draw travel from the outer right toward the convergence point, with erase reversing it.
rtlDecisions.why: The sweep direction carries the diagram's reading order; the original stagger and duration remain intact.

rtlDecisions.what: S1–S4 labels and four-source vertical ordering
rtlDecisions.action: Kept LTR identifier glyph order and top-to-bottom stacking; removed nonzero letter spacing.
rtlDecisions.why: These are compact identifiers, and the vertical source arrangement is physical layout rather than horizontal reading order.

rtlDecisions.action: Moved badge to the mirrored convergence coordinate; kept the mark's shape and orientation unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: Its location participates in the reading flow, while the centered geometric symbol is a physical, symmetric mark.

rtlDecisions.action: Translated to «چهار منبع یکپارچه», placed beneath the badge, and retained the original word-by-word color progression in RTL order. Removed tracking and used logical word spacing.
rtlDecisions.why: The caption is Persian UI copy; reading and emphasis begin at the right edge.

rtlDecisions.what: Canvas centering, vertical coordinates, circles, and star symbol
rtlDecisions.action: Kept centered canvas, all y coordinates, circular shapes, and star orientation unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: These are symmetric or vertical composition/physical geometry and do not carry RTL reading semantics.

rasterHandling.assets: None. The component uses vector paths and CSS shapes only.

verification.comparisons: Viewed Persian and original side-by-side at frames 48, 80, and 160. Verified early convergence path alignment, mid-convergence node and packet alignment, and final Persian caption fit.
verification.visualResult: The mirrored path geometry, nodes, packets, badge, and caption are aligned; the caption fits and no unintended English or Chinese prose appears.
